crossRefs.note: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.

parallels.note: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

translations.web: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.
translations.bsb: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
translations.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
translations.asv: and whosoever would be first among you, shall be servant of all.
